The '''weather-control station''' was a structure located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] that could create various atmospheric phenomena. During the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]], it was destroyed by a small [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike force. There was also a weather control station located on [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]] just outside the perimeter of [[Spaceport Southeast II|Bonadan Spaceport Southeast II]] around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].
